headline: Sees opportunity to boost shipments to China
summary: The CCE business council said the meeting between Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum and Chinese President Xi Jinping opens a window to expand exports to China. It called for an aggressive export strategy.
why: China is one of the largest trading partners for Asian and Latin American economies, so market access decisions shape export revenues and trade flows.
original_headline: Ven oportunidad para elevar envíos a China
